title: Defense department contacts privately encourage Rossi
summary: Dave Rossi tells of Defense department contacts privately encourage Rossi, about 2021-2024 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: meeting with people inside of you know, the defense department and uh, officially, there was no um, no way that they could uh, support me, but privately, they were encouraging me

plain: Dave Rossi, a man who says advanced physics came to him from non-human sources, tells of meeting people inside the US Department of Defense between about 2021 and 2024. He says that officially they had no way to support him, but privately they encouraged him, which he takes as a sign that people inside the military took his claims seriously.
